name: MODULAR_CUBIC_OBFUSCATION
description: Replaced the matrix trace condition with a mathematically equivalent modular cubic equation, and transformed the "lexicographically smallest" tie-breaker into minimizing a base-3 integer. This defeats models that rely on keyword-matching "lexicographical" to trigger standard BFS 2-coloring tie-break routines, forcing them to mathematically deduce both the bipartiteness and the positional weighting.
